_comment: Every key here is optional - the plugin ships with working defaults and starts happily with no config.json at all. There are no credentials any more: announcements go through ArkCrossChat, which owns the database.
_comment_names: Who the announcement appears to come from in chat.
_comment_prefix: Put in front of the biome description.
message_prefix: A new asteroid biome has been reached. Asteroid Biome contains:
_comment_biomes: Indexed by the game's NetEndWarp zone number, so ORDER IS THE CONTRACT. If you provide this list it replaces the built-in one wholesale rather than merging, because a partial list would shift every index after the one you changed and announce the wrong biome. Last checked against the game 2023-09-09.
biomes: Ambergris, mutagel, metal and white supply crates.
Crystal, metal and green supply crates.
Metal, obsidian, sulfur and cyan supply crates.
Element shards, metal and purple supply crates.
Metal, gems, obsidian and yellow supply crates.
Metal, oil and red supply crates.
Element dust, metal and cyan supply crates.
Black pearls, mutagel, obsidian, metal and orange supply crates.
